findings.title: Potential hidden instructions for AI agents
findings.evidence: 1 hidden/comment segment(s) matched: ignore previous, tool instruction; content withheld, hashes: 7c9a8c3bc7bb1d87
findings.remediation: Treat page content as untrusted data. Remove hidden agent-directed instructions or isolate them from model context.

findings.title: No clickjacking protection detected
findings.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors is present

findings.title: Sensitive-looking cookie 'sessionid' is missing HttpOnly
findings.evidence: Cookie 'sessionid' looks session/auth related and does not set HttpOnly
findings.remediation: Set HttpOnly unless client-side JavaScript truly needs access.

findings.title: Cookie 'sessionid' is missing Secure
findings.evidence: Cookie 'sessionid' does not set the Secure attribute
findings.remediation: Set Secure for cookies transmitted over HTTPS.

findings.title: Outdated jQuery 3.4.1 detected
findings.remediation: Upgrade jQuery and test dependent plugins. Versions before 3.5.0 are affected by known XSS issues including CVE-2020-11022/11023.

findings.title: Content Security Policy is missing
findings.remediation: Deploy a restrictive CSP and iterate with report-only mode first.

findings.title: HSTS is missing
findings.remediation: Enable HSTS after confirming all subdomains are HTTPS-ready.

findings.title: Potential active/passive mixed content
findings.evidence: HTTPS page references at least one http:// asset
findings.remediation: Serve all assets over HTTPS or use relative HTTPS-safe URLs.

findings.title: Cookie 'sessionid' has no SameSite attribute
findings.evidence: Cookie 'sessionid' does not set a SameSite attribute
findings.remediation: Set SameSite=Lax or Strict unless cross-site behavior is required.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy is missing
findings.remediation: Set a policy such as strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

findings.title: Technology/version disclosure in response headers
findings.remediation: Remove unnecessary version/product headers where practical.

findings.title: Third-party scripts without Subresource Integrity
findings.evidence: 1 cross-origin script(s) lack an integrity attribute
findings.remediation: Where assets are version-pinned and static, consider SRI or self-hosting. Dynamic scripts may not be compatible with SRI.
